name: MovingAverage
description: Running mean of samples over a variable rectangular time window. The window length (numsamp) is modulatable up to maxsamp; memory is pre-allocated for maxsamp. Use .power for time-averaged power and .rms for root-mean-square. From sc3-plugins QuantityUGens.

inputs.name: numsamp
inputs.description: Size of the averaging window in samples (modulatable, clipped to maxsamp)

inputs.name: maxsamp
inputs.description: Maximum window size; pre-allocates memory and is non-modulatable

name: MovingSum
description: Running sum of samples over a variable rectangular time window. The window length (numsamp) is modulatable up to maxsamp; memory is pre-allocated for maxsamp. Useful for time-averaging operations — see MovingAverage for normalised output. From sc3-plugins QuantityUGens.

inputs.name: numsamp
inputs.description: Size of the summing window in samples (modulatable, clipped to maxsamp)

inputs.name: maxsamp
inputs.description: Maximum window size; pre-allocates memory and is non-modulatable
